blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Water Non-East Zone operating unit Boracay Water reaffirmed its commitment to protecting Boracay Island’s fragile environment as it joins the newly reorganized Wastewater Management Council (WMC) of the Municipality of Malay, a multi-stakeholder body tasked with strengthening wastewater governance, environmental protection, and public health initiatives across the island. The reorganization of the WMC, through Executive Order No. 22, Series of 2026, signed by Malay Mayor Frolibar Bautista, reinforces the local government’s efforts to address increasing wastewater management challenges brought about by population growth and tourism activities.
